answer:
I did not relaunch it. A relaunch would fail identically, and query_aap2 is read-only.

The download got HTTP 404 for https://artifacts.labcdn.example/ocp-clients/latest-4.2/openshift-install-linux-el9.tar.gz. The job asked for the latest-4.2 installer, not 4.20. 4.2 predates the el9 installer builds, so that file has never existed. The artifact server answered correctly.

The 4.2 comes from the catalog item. rhpds/agnosticv:summit_events/summit-mesh-lab/common.yaml line 14 reads `ocp4_installer_version: 4.20`, unquoted. YAML parses an unquoted 4.20 as the float 4.2: the trailing zero is lost before Ansible ever sees it. The log's own debug line confirms it: ocp4_installer_version=4.2.

Fix: quote it, `ocp4_installer_version: "4.20"`. Every relaunch of this item fails the same way until then.

Category: configuration. Confidence: high.
